verses.text: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies. Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, and no torment will touch them. In the eyes of the foolish they seemed to have died. Their departure was considered a disaster, and their travel away from us ruin, but they are in peace.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.

But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me. In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you. If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.” “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.
Jesus wept.
Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.
But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound, to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favour and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn.
Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
For his anger is but for a moment. His favour is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

For the Lord will not cast off forever. For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses. For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ, who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith. From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us.

Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you.
I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labours, for their works follow with them.”

They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat; for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgement, but has passed out of death into life.
For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection.

For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted; a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up; a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance.
But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth. After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh.
But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me.

Then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever. Therefore comfort one another with these words.

For if he wasn’t expecting that those who had fallen would rise again, it would be superfluous and idle to pray for the dead. But if he was looking forward to an honourable memorial of gratitude laid up for those who die in godliness, then the thought was holy and godly. Therefore he made the atoning sacrifice for those who had died, that they might be released from their sin.
Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
But a righteous man, even if he dies before his time, will be at rest.
Come to me, all you who labour and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy. Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

messages.text: Okunakuwala kwe kwagala nga tewali we kugenda. Kikube Katonda, kubanga ye yennyini kwagala.
Yesu yakaaba ku ntaana ya mukwano gwe Lazaro. Akuba ne mmwe kati.
Okufa si kwe kukoma. Mu Kristo, obulamu bukyusibwa, tebutwalibwa.
Omwagalwa wo ali mu mikono gya Katonda, era tewali kubonaabona kuyinza kumukwata.
Saba olw'omwoyo gw'oyo gwe wafiirwa. Okusaba kwo kukyabatuukako n'okwagala.
Okunakuwala tekugoberera kalenda. Twala ekiseera kyonna ky'oyagala.
Mary yali akutte omubiri gw'Omwana we ku bigere by'omusaalaba. Ategeera ennaku yo.
Obumu bw'abatukuvu kitegeeza nti okwagala tekutemebwa kufa.
Tekirina buzibu okukaaba, okujjukira n'okubabulwa. Ekyo kwe kwagala.
Olunaku lumu buli zziga lijja kuba nga liggyiddwawo. Kuumira ku kisuubizo ekyo.
Kuba n'okukulembera okusaba kw'ekibiina ku lw'omwagalwa wo. Kye kimu ku birabo ebisingayo obulungi by'oyinza okuwa.
Kristo agenda mu maaso okuteekateeka ekifo. Okufa kye kisenge, si bbugwe.
Okunakuwala kusobola okujja mu mpeke. Bwe kuba nga kulinnye, yisa omukka ogambe nti Yesu, nkukkiririzaamu.
Bategeeza erinnya lyabwe mu kusaba. Katonda alimanyi, era akyabagala.
Okuwummula okutaggwaawo kubaweebwe, Mukama waffe, era ekitangaala ekitaliggwaawo kibakoleko.
Tolina kubeera munene eri buli muntu. Leka abalala bakubudaabude nabo.
Okukkiriza tekuggya nnaku, naye kuwa essuubi mu nnaku.
Obulamu bw'omwagalwa wo kyali kirabo. Weebaza Katonda olw'emyaka gye mwamala nga muli wamu.
Okufa kufiiriddwa obusobozi bwakwo kubanga Kristo azuukidde.
Genda ku ntaana zaabwe oba mu kkanisa osabe. Okwagala kusobola okwogera.
Kyekyangu okubuuza lwaki. Leeta ebibuuzo byo eri Katonda; asobola okubikwata.
Mukama ali kumpi n'abo abalina emitima egimenyese. Omutima gwo gumenyese, kyenva mmanyi nti Mukama ali kumpi.
Okunakuwala kuyinza okukukyusa, naye Katonda asobola okukufuula omuntu ow'ekisa, ow'amagezi era ow'okusaasira ng'ayitira mu kubonaabona.
Kwata ku by'ojjukira. Bya muwendo Katonda bye yakuwa.
Mu ggulu temuli kukaaba, kulira oba bulumi. Eyo y'ensonga lwaki okwagala kugenda eyo.
Ab'omu maka g'ekigo kyo bakuyambe. Ekyo kye ky'Ekkanisa ky'eriwo okukola.
Mutabani wa Ssande Monica yawandiika ku kufa kwe ng'alina amaziga n'essuubi. Bombi bali wamu.
Bw'owulira ng'olina omusango ku bintu ebitayogeddwa, gamba Katonda kati. Asobola okutwala ebigambo byo eri abantu abo.
Omuntu wo omwagalwa talina gy'alaga. Omanyi gy'olina okumunoonya: mu mutima gwa Katonda.
Bakoleere omuliro gw'ekibiriiti, akabonero akatono ak'omusana gwa Kristo.
Wajja kubaawo essanyu nate. Kiyinza okulabika nga tekisoboka kati, naye Katonda ajja kukireeta.
Lya, wummule era okkirize obuyambi. Okunakuwala kukooya omubiri n'omutima.
Saba omwagalwa wo, bw'aba ali ne Katonda, akusabire.
Okuzuukira kwe kuddamu eri buli kuziika.
Ne mu nnaku, osobola okwesiga nti Katonda mulungi era nti ekisa kye kinene.
Okunakuwala kye kigula okwagala, ate okwagala bulijjo kuba kwa mugaso.
Tewali muntu yenna alabye era tewali n'omu awulidde ebyo Katonda by'ategekedde abamwagala.
Leeka essapule ekukwatire ng'ebigambo byo bikomye.
Yogera n'omuntu ku kufiirwa kwo. Okugabana ennaku kituusa ku nnaku entono.
Omutukuvu Yozefu, omuwabuzi w'okufa okw'emirembe, tusabire n'abo bonna abaafa.
Emboozi y'omwagalwa wo egenda mu maaso emirembe gyonna, era n'okwagala kwo bwe kutyo.
Ennaku ezimu zijja kuba nzibu okusinga endala. Ekyo kyabulijjo. Beera mugumiikiriza gy'oli.
Emyoyo gy'abatuukirivu giri mu mukono gwa Katonda. Wummulira mu mazima ago ekiro kino.
Yesu yasuubiza omubbi eyali ku musaalaba nti, Olwa leero ojja kuba nange mu Lusuku lwa Katonda. Ekisa kye kyali kinene nnyo.
Abantu abakungubaga ba mukisa, Yesu yagamba kubanga bajja kuba babudaabudibwa.
Jjukira nti Katonda yayagala omwagalwa wo okusinga bw'omwagala ggwe.
Osobola okutwala mu maaso okwagala kwabwe ng'obeera n'ekisa n'okukkiriza.
Ennyumba bw'ewulira nga nkalu, yita Yesu ajjuze ekiseera ekyo.
Olunaku lumu mujja kuddamu okubeera awamu mu ssanyu ery'omu ggulu. Okutuusa ku olwo, mweyongere okukkiriza.
Wummula ekiro kino. Omwagalwa wo ali mu mikono gya Katonda, era naawe bw'otyo.
